description: Request reference cases that do not match the pinned Ruby capture exactly. 'detail': Ruby class and public message prefix match; the parser or OS diagnostic text differs. 'pending': known divergence owned outside the request module.

alias-value.reason: Psych.safe_load(permitted_classes: [Symbol]) load policy: Date/Time/arbitrary Ruby classes and aliases are rejected as 'Error loading request file: ...'. Needs typed Ruby value resolution and alias detection from the shared loader/model owner (K17-MODELS); Yeptris expands aliases and returns plain strings for timestamps.
